### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

For new competitors, this video may help with competing. 
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLW9gGoCICXgJ3um3OlsrYUq1k0iAazxck

Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

### (FR)

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.


### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de compétition WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. 
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLW9gGoCICXgJ3um3OlsrYUq1k0iAazxck

Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

## Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad.

Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos Rubik? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura.

During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community.

And what better way to express this connection than through Rubik's Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we're not only showcasing skill and dexterity but also the ability to come together in a common challenge, regardless of our background or culture.

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.


## NOTICE OF FILMING:

Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.

## VENUE

Oppi Dak is situated inside the Gateway Corner Centre. It is located on the first floor right above Liquor City and can be accessed via the stairs or the lift. 
The venue will provide a variety of food, snacks and drinks on both days and also offer card and cash payment options.
On Sunday they also serve a separate Buffet Lunch which you are more than welcome to take part in.
Bathroom facilities are available inside the venue, and the Centre itself also provides alternative bathrooms outside of the venue itself.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

# Điều kiện tham dự thi Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5

Các thí sinh tham dự các nội dung **Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5** phải đạt điều kiện sau:
* Thí sinh phải có **ít nhất một lượt** Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 thành công.
* Kết quả Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 tốt nhất của thí sinh đạt **Top 20** trong số các thí sinh đã đăng ký thi nội dung tương ứng.
Các thí sinh không đạt những điều kiện này sẽ **không được tham dự thi** các nội dung tương ứng và sẽ được hoàn 100% lệ phí các môn này (nếu đã nộp).
# Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh

Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu.

## Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024

[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/) are excited to team up with [Rubik's](https://rubiks.com) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com) to bring speedcubing all-stars together for an official WCA competition at the Mall of America® in Bloomington, Minnesota! 

## Qualification

To qualify to register for this competition, you must have an official sub-7.00 3x3x3 average. This result must have occurred at a competition that took place on or before March 21, 2024.

If you don't qualify for this competition, look for one of the many other opportunities to compete in the Midwest area, including [Minnesota Warm Up 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaWarmUp2024) on July 13 and July 14, also being held at the Mall of America! 

We also invite you to watch Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 via the livestream, or if you are in the area stop by the Mall of America® and watch it live!

## Spectators and Livestream

We're thrilled to put competitive speedcubing on display via the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 livestream. See the Livestream tab for more details.

The event will be open to in-person spectators who will be able to view this competition from mulitple levels of the Mall of America®, including on the jumbotron that will be projected in the Huntington Bank Rotunda. Reserved VIP seating will also be available for up to two guests for each competitor.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 competition consent to their images being used by Midwest Cubing Association and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

To Athens TableTop Open 2024 είναι ο 6ος διαγωνισμός της WCA στην Ελλάδα για το 2024.  
Ο διαγωνισμός γίνεται στις 7 Ιουλίου 2024 στο κλειστό Ολυμπιακό γήπεδο του Τάεκβοντο στην Αθήνα στο Δέλτα Φαλήρου κατά την διάρκεια του Φεστιβάλ Επιτραπέζιων Παιχνιδιών [Athens Tabletop](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/).

Το Athens TableTop Open 2024 τελεί υπό την αιγίδα της WCA και διοργανώνεται από το ηλεκτρονικό κατάστημα [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , την [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) και την [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/), οι οποίες ανήκουν στην εταιρεία [Καινοτομίες Βερδέ ΑΕΒΕ](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste).

Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε για μια μοναδική εμπειρία και γιορτή του cubing!
Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τόσο την παρούσα σελίδα όσο και τις επόμενες σελίδες  

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί **το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντίτιμου συμμετοχής όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα** . 

Επίσης, για την είσοδό σας στον χώρο θα χρειαστεί **ξεχωριστό εισιτήριο για την έκθεση** αξίας 8 ευρώ για μία μέρα ή 14 για το διήμερο, το οποίο σας παρέχει πρόσβαση σε όλο τον χώρο της έκθεσης, όπου μπορείτε να γνωρίσετε τόσο τα προϊόντα μας, όσο και πολλών ακόμα εκθετών. Εισιτήρια για το φεστιβάλ θα βρείτε εδώ [εδώ.](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/tickets2024/)

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RS768gK0Vrg&feature=youtu.be)

Σημείωση Αποδοχής κινηματογράφησης ή φωτογράφισης. 
Οι διαγωνιζόμενοι και οι συμμετέχοντες με την συμμετοχή τους στο Athens TableTop Open 2024 αυτόματα συμφωνούν με την πιθανή χρήση των εικόνων τους από τους διοργανωτές σε προωθητικές ενέργειες, κοινωνικά δίκτυα και άλλες ψηφιακές ενέργειες.

Οι online εγγραφές ανοίγουν στη 1η Ιουνίου 2024 και κλείνουν στις 30 Ιουνίου 2024.

The competition is taking place on the 7th of July during the Festival of Board Games ["Athens Tabletop"](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/?lang=en), at the [Athens Tae Kwon Do Stadium](https://www.facebook.com/taekwondofaliro/), which is located in the Faliron Delta of Athens.

items.information:
Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Åkers Styckebruk!

Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken [koncept](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept).

-----

A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Åkers Styckebruk! 

Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the [concept tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept).
